description: This file contains template implementations and utility functions for safe numeric conversions, range checking, and type promotions within the Chromium codebase, specifically for handling numeric limits, type traits, and conversion boundary checks.

classes.name: RangeCheck
classes.description: A class representing the result of range validation checks, indicating underflow or overflow conditions.

classes.name: NarrowingRange
classes.description: A template struct that adjusts range bounds for conversions between floating point and integral types to prevent precision and overflow issues.

classes.name: CheckedNumeric
classes.description: Placeholder class template for numeric types with safety checks (not implemented here).

classes.name: ClampedNumeric
classes.description: Placeholder class template for numeric types with clamping behavior (not implemented here).

classes.name: StrictNumeric
classes.description: Placeholder class template for strict numeric types (not implemented here).

methods.name: IsValueNegative
methods.description: Checks if a numeric value is negative, specialized for signed and unsigned types.

methods.name: ConditionalNegate
methods.description: Performs a fast negation, returning a signed value, working on unsigned arguments.

methods.name: SafeUnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an integral type as an unsigned, avoiding overflow.

methods.name: CanDetectCompileTimeConstant
methods.description: Detects if the compiler can evaluate constants at compile time.

methods.name: IsCompileTimeConstant
methods.description: Checks if a value is a compile-time constant.

methods.name: MustTreatAsConstexpr
methods.description: Determines if a value should be treated as constexpr based on compile-time detection.

methods.name: HandleFailure
methods.description: Triggers a crash or trap for numeric boundary errors.

methods.name: RangeCheck
methods.description: Represents the result of a range validation, indicating overflow or underflow.

methods.name: Adjust
methods.description: Adjusts a value to fit within range bounds, considering floating point and integral types.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for a type, adjusted for range checks.

methods.name: lowest
methods.description: Returns the lowest value for a type, adjusted for range checks.

methods.name: DstRangeRelationToSrcRange
methods.description: Checks if the range of a destination type can contain the range of a source type.
